props.name: label
props.description: Top label displayed above the slider.

props.name: labelHint
props.description: Optional hint displayed to the right of the label.

props.name: labelClass
props.description: Custom Tailwind classes applied to the label element.

props.name: containerClass
props.description: Custom Tailwind classes applied to the outer container.

props.name: size
props.description: Size scale of the range slider (`"sm"` | `"md"` | `"lg"`). Defaults to `"md"`.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum allowed numeric value of the slider.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum allowed numeric value of the slider.

props.name: step
props.description:
Step increment precision for thumbs (e.g. `1`, `5`, `10`, `0.5`).
Defaults to `1`.

props.name: valueMin
props.description: The current selected minimum value (left thumb).

props.name: valueMax
props.description: The current selected maximum value (right thumb).

props.name: valueSuffix
props.description: Optional string appended to displayed values (e.g. `"kg"`, `"₹"`, `"%"`, `"hrs"`).

props.name: showTooltips
props.description: Floating value tooltip popups displayed above active thumbs on drag or hover.

props.name: marks
props.description: Custom tick marks and labels displayed along slider track (e.g. `{ 0: '$0', 50: '$50', 100: '$100' }`).

props.name: error
props.description: Error message to display below the slider.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Guidance helper text rendered below the slider.

props.name: showErrorMessage
props.description:
Whether the error message should be shown.
Defaults to true.
